title: Black-Beast-Squad · Mountain Clearing
caveats: Recorded completions, not decoded commands or an executable build order.
Resource snapshots use original timestamps sampled at least one minute apart plus the last snapshot.

Spending is inferred from provider fields named *Gathered that end at or below the final resources spent; per-time gathered totals, population, army value and worker splits are not recorded and the app derives labelled estimates at view time.
